- [Brown bears and birch forests: the wild Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/brown-bears-and-birch-forests.html): New Zealand has no large wild mammals. North-west Spain has brown bears and capercaillie. Where to see them, and where to live.

- [Green Spain: for Britons who don't want the Costas](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/green-spain-for-brits-who-dont-want-the-costas.html): Mountains, forests, four seasons and stone villages: the Spain most British buyers never see, and why the Laciana Valley could suit you.
